listing.aiSummary: Merges content from Torchships and Seeker into a single mod with various changes.

description: Combines the vast majority of content from the Torchships and Seeker mods. Includes a variety of changes to balancing and ship distribution. Features a custom start scenario called 'A Knight's Tale' that provides a developed colony with added progress and debt.
